scope.decisions: fleet-ops-033 (2026-11-05T23:18Z) supersedes the dependency freshness rule only: local done/archive/mark evidence may satisfy a listed id even in a stale list, absent any remote open row; no list or no listed id remains UNKNOWN. PR ownership still requires a fresh list. Self-qualified local marks are supported. Six-hour freshness, TSV-only verdicts and the R6 cut-13b exclusion remain.

lifecycle_transitions: fresh -> stale: local done/archive/mark satisfaction persists for listed ids with no remote opens; remote-qualified done satisfaction and definitive PR ownership become UNKNOWN; stale warnings stay visible
list or listed-id removal -> local completion becomes UNKNOWN; adding listed identity -> eligible local completion may satisfy, even in a stale list
queued -> ready withheld or ready from listed completion; local and remote open rows always override local completion
main orphan wake; candidate secondmate UNKNOWN wake; noncandidate secondmate silence
exited/released-copy local task -> guarded relaunch only after known local ownership
known remote task -> one-way steer only to selected registered home; ambiguous/unreadable/done owner -> refusal
mark -> repeated mark no-op -> reopened row blocks -> unmark restores unresolved edge
dry run -> no control/send/forge writes; repeated pass -> unchanged verdicts and no duplicate steer/launch
self-qualified mark -> repeated no-op -> unmark restores the exact qualified target; a reopened local target or listed remote open overrides the mark
